title: Titan
text:
Titan is an Ascendancy class for the Warrior.


== Overview ==
The Titan is a class that possesses tremendous vitality and might. He can deliver powerful slams that can be ancestrally boosted and leave extra aftershocks, and improve his Heavy Stuns by making them easier to apply and dealing more damage to stunned enemies. The Titan can also be built to be very resilient with access to more life and armour. He can also gain extra inventory space from Colossal Capacity, which unlocks the ability to improve the power of his small passive skills from Hulking Form.
